description: Catalogue of the identifier codes this service validates (250+ across 90 countries plus international standards), filterable by country and category. Free. Call it once to find the right code for validate_identifier. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = check-digit algorithm from a public specification; medium = community-documented checksum or pattern-only; low = structure only), estimated_items[], sources[], data_version and a disclaimer (structural validation only — never proof that an identifier is issued or belongs to someone).

category.description: Filter: personal | tax | company | bank | securities | product | device | vehicle | postal | algorithm | other.
category.title: Category

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter by (e.g. 'AE', 'DE'), or 'INTL' for international identifiers. Omit for all.
country.title: Country
